entries.3697d6df319ddb68: The company manufactures and sells rice processing machines, including sushi rice processing machines (sushi robots) and topping rice processing machines (topping robots). entries.e694f0ac6c441993: Its 3-year medium-term management plan “Next 2028,” starting with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its first year, takes as its basic policies “Building a truly global corporate structure,” “Evolving into a company that creates added value” and “Establishing a corporate foundation for sustainable growth,” and states that it will work on growing its business mainly in North America overseas, expanding the market for the rice-portioning robot Fuwarica in Japan, and improving production capacity through a switch to a line production method at a new plant.
